items.title: NASA Science
items.summary: If you stare into space for a long time, what might you see? At first, you might only see the usual brightest stars, but if your eyes (or camera) could continue to collect light, you would see increasingly more. In the direction of the featured image, after only a few minutes, you would begin to notice some regions without stars. items.label: From the classics
items.title: Laozi — Tao Teh King
items.summary: The highest excellence is like that of water. The excellence of water appears in its benefiting all things, and in its occupying, without striving, the low place which all men dislike.

items.label: Poem
items.title: חיים נחמן ביאליק — הכניסיני תחת כנפך
items.summary:
הַכּוֹכָבִים רִמּוּ אוֹתִי,
הָיָה חֲלוֹם – אַךְ גַּם הוּא עָבָר;
עַתָּה אֵין לִי כְלוּם בָּעוֹלָם –
אֵין לִי דָבָר.
